info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Weather Alerts Radars-v4-spec
info.description: The Weather Alerts Radar API provides real-time access to weather alerts and radar data, ensuring users are informed of severe weather conditions. It enables the retrieval of current alert statuses and radar imagery, serving as a critical tool for meteorologists, emergency response teams, and developers integrating weather information into applications. Typical consumers include local government agencies, weather-related mobile apps, and research institutions. By leveraging this API, users can enhance their situational awareness and improve safety measures in their respective operations.

get.description: Fetches a list of radar alerts for the current context. This endpoint allows you to access the latest notifications and warnings related to radar events. It's essential for keeping track of any important alerts in a timely manner.

requestBody.description: This request body allows you to fetch radar alerts. It should include all necessary parameters to specify the desired filtering criteria for the alerts.
